us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic developments across the United States

articles.title: Severe Thanksgiving weather brings flooding and travel disruption across the US
bullets: Heavy rain, wind and flooding affected much of the country on Thanksgiving.
The storm system complicated holiday travel during one of the busiest periods.
Officials warned drivers to avoid flooded roads and monitor local alerts.

articles.title: Federal judge blocks FCC early review of ABC broadcast licenses
bullets: A judge halted an early FCC review of ABC broadcast licenses.
ABC and Disney argued the review chilled the network’s speech rights.
The case is part of broader clashes between the administration and media outlets.

articles.title: Trump administration unveils new tariff proposals for major trading partners
bullets: The administration proposed new tariffs targeting China, the EU, India and others.
Officials framed the measures as pressure on partners over trade with China.
The tariff plans drew scrutiny after midterm voter concerns about the economy.

articles.title: US-led investor group agrees to acquire Lukoil overseas assets
bullets: A consortium led by US billionaire Todd Boehly agreed to buy Lukoil assets.
The deal involves the Russian oil company’s overseas operations.
Reports described the transaction as US-backed amid sanctions-linked energy reshuffling.

articles.title: Treasury debt-limit fight looms as new Congress prepares to take office
bullets: The US is nearing its $41.1 trillion borrowing limit.
A showdown could unfold after Democrats take congressional control.
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent faces pressure over fiscal deadlines.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major international stories and geopolitical developments

articles.title: European leaders weigh talks with Putin over Ukraine security architecture
bullets: European officials discussed engaging Moscow on a future security framework.
Ukraine pressed allies for written commitments rather than verbal assurances.
EU leaders were set to debate Ukraine funding in Brussels.

articles.title: Kim Jong Un calls for wider tactical nuclear deployment
bullets: North Korea’s leader urged deployment of tactical nuclear weapons across domains.
State media said nuclear material production capacity was expanding systematically.
The remarks added to regional security concerns in East Asia.

articles.title: Serbia schedules presidential election after protest movement’s parliamentary win
bullets: Serbia will hold presidential elections on December 27.
The vote follows a student-led protest movement’s October parliamentary victory.
The announcement came from newly elected Parliament Speaker Aleksandar Cupic.

articles.title: Trump and NATO chief warn Putin not to expand the war
bullets: Donald Trump and NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte issued a joint statement.
They warned Russia against broadening the conflict beyond Ukraine.
Reuters reported the statement amid renewed diplomacy over European security.

articles.title: South Korea raises rates and upgrades growth forecast
bullets: South Korea’s central bank raised its benchmark interest rate.
Officials also upgraded the country’s 2027 growth outlook.
Reports cited stronger AI-linked demand as a growth driver.

articles.title: India reviews US proposal for tariffs of up to 25% on Indian goods
bullets: Washington proposed tariffs of up to 25% on Indian goods.
The rate could be capped lower if India reaches a trade deal.
India rejected allegations of excess manufacturing capacity.

articles.title: India pitches 2036 Olympics bid to IOC
bullets: India presented its 2036 Olympics bid to the International Olympic Committee.
Ahmedabad was reported as the proposed host city.
The pitch is part of India’s long-running Olympic hosting ambitions.
articles.source: Times of India / Reports via RealFeed

articles.title: RBI brings more than 60 tonnes of gold back to India in six months
bullets: The Reserve Bank of India repatriated 60.08 tonnes of gold.
The transfer occurred over a six-month period.
The move was reported alongside wider financial-sector updates.

articles.title: Supreme Court receives contempt plea over unlit Madurai lamp
bullets: A contempt plea involving the Madurai lamp reached the Supreme Court.
The matter was listed among new India developments on November 26.
Further court action will determine the next procedural steps.

articles.title: Meta says it restricted more than 54 lakh posts in India in early 2026
bullets: Meta reported restricting over 54 lakh posts in India.
The restrictions occurred in the first half of 2026.
The filing was dated November 25 and seen by Reuters.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: US market moves and notable stock action

articles.title: US stock market closed for Thanksgiving after volatile Wednesday session
bullets: US stock and bond markets were closed Thursday for Thanksgiving.
Stocks reopen Friday with an early 1 p.m. ET close.
Thin post-holiday trading could magnify market moves.

articles.title: Nasdaq falls 0.6% as AI stock selloff eases late Wednesday
bullets: The Nasdaq Composite ended Wednesday down 0.6%.
It recovered from a much steeper intraday decline.
AI-related stocks remained the main source of pressure.

articles.title: Nvidia drops as chip stocks lead market losses
bullets: Nvidia fell 3.9% in Wednesday trading.
Micron, Lam Research and Sandisk also posted sharp declines.
Concerns over AI infrastructure spending weighed on chip shares.

articles.title: HP leads S&P 500 gainers after market rebound
bullets: HP was cited as the top S&P 500 performer Wednesday.
Shares gained 11.49% during the session.
The move came despite broader weakness in technology shares.

articles.title: Anthropic closes below IPO price during AI-stock reset
bullets: Anthropic slid 6.5% in Tuesday trading.
Shares closed below the $83 IPO price for the first time.
The move reflected pressure on newly listed AI companies.

articles.title: Black Friday shoppers mix essentials with holiday gifts as prices stay high
bullets: Consumers are buying necessities alongside electronics, toys and gifts.
Salesforce said November discounts are larger than last year.
Retailers hope lower gasoline prices support holiday spending.

articles.title: Airbus satellite deal aims to create European SpaceX rival
bullets: Airbus is merging satellite operations with Leonardo and Thales units.
The planned joint venture would compete with SpaceX.
Bloomberg reporting was cited in Axios Pro Rata.

articles.title: Boehly-led group reaches deal for Lukoil global assets
bullets: Todd Boehly led a US-backed consortium in the transaction.
The agreement covers Lukoil’s overseas assets.
Multiple outlets reported the deal on November 26.

articles.title: Maersk discusses expanded Suez Canal cooperation with Egypt
bullets: Egypt’s president met Maersk CEO Vincent Clerc in Cairo.
They discussed expanding cooperation and company operations through the Suez Canal.
The talks focused on shipping and logistics activity.
articles.source: Global New Light of Myanmar / Sputnik

articles.title: Babcock shares rise after UK nuclear submarine facilities contract
bullets: Babcock International shares rose 5.8% in London.
Britain signed an £8 billion contract with the defense company.
The project covers upgrades to nuclear submarine facilities.

articles.title: AI shares rebound globally after Wall Street tech rout
bullets: Technology shares recovered in parts of Europe and Asia.
US markets were closed Thursday for Thanksgiving.
The rebound followed a sharp pullback in AI-linked stocks.

articles.title: Concerns grow over Nvidia customer Megaspeed’s China links
bullets: TIME examined red flags around Nvidia customer Megaspeed.
Megaspeed said it complies with applicable export controls.
The story comes amid scrutiny of AI-chip supply chains.

articles.title: AI infrastructure cost worries pressure chip and cloud stocks
bullets: Investors sold AI-linked semiconductor and cloud shares this week.
Nvidia, AMD, Micron and Oracle were among pressured names.
The selloff reflected doubts about future AI profit expectations.

articles.title: Starlink expands across more than half of Africa
bullets: Starlink service has expanded to 30 of Africa’s 54 countries.
The rollout began in Nigeria in 2023.
Satellite internet growth is accelerating across multiple African regions.

articles.title: US tech outages keep cybersecurity and infrastructure resilience in focus
bullets: November outages affected major technology and transport systems.
Authorities examined cyber risks after disruptions to critical services.
The incidents intensified concerns about digital infrastructure reliability.
articles.source: Wikipedia summary citing AP / Reuters / USA Today
